summary: TRACK 23.3 V3 Daily Report Surfacing + Field Resiliency — backend flag admin API fully certified (18/18 pytest live tests green). Frontend flag persistence, autosave, restore-prompt, mobile no-hscroll, offline chip all pass. ONE bug: DraftStatusPill data-testid=dr-v3-draft-pill never renders in V3 header (prop-name mismatch — savedAt vs lastSavedAt AND data-testid vs testId).

ui_bugs.issue: DraftStatusPill never renders in header — even after typing (autosave fires, restore-prompt works after reload, so draftStatus transitions do happen). Root cause: (a) V3 passes `savedAt={pendingSavedAt}` but DraftStatusPill expects prop `lastSavedAt`; (b) V3 passes `data-testid="dr-v3-draft-pill"` but the component reads `testId` prop and renders `data-testid={testId||'draft-status-pill'}`. Even if the pill did render, its DOM testid would be the default `draft-status-pill`, not `dr-v3-draft-pill`. Spec says the pill must render even at idle — currently the header shows NO pill at all (status=idle && lastSavedAt=undefined → component returns null).

action_items: Fix DraftStatusPill wiring in /app/frontend/src/pages/NewDailyReportV3.jsx line ~307: change `savedAt={pendingSavedAt}` → `lastSavedAt={pendingSavedAt}` and `data-testid="dr-v3-draft-pill"` → `testId="dr-v3-draft-pill"`. Additionally, if spec requires the pill to render even at idle with no prior save (as review request states), consider always emitting an idle-state pill: DraftStatusPill currently returns null when status==='idle' && !lastSavedAt. Either change the component to render an idle badge, or wrap the pill in NewDailyReportV3 to always render a fallback.

rca of the issue: DraftStatusPill props: component signature is `{status, lastSavedAt, lastError, testId='draft-status-pill'}`. V3 caller passes `savedAt` and `data-testid` (React-standard names) instead of the component's camelCase `lastSavedAt` / `testId` prop names. Consequence: (1) at idle with no autosave activity, `lastSavedAt=undefined` → the component's terminal branch `status==='idle' && !lastSavedAt` → returns null → no pill in DOM; (2) even during saving/saved transitions, the rendered `<span>` uses default testId='draft-status-pill', so `[data-testid=dr-v3-draft-pill]` selector never matches. Fix: two-line change in NewDailyReportV3.jsx lines 307-311. Optionally decide whether the component itself should render an idle-state chip when neither status nor lastSavedAt are present (spec says pill must render even at idle).
